bagPolicy.summary: For safety and efficiency, only small clutches, belt bags, fanny-packs, or clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” are allowed. Backpacks are not permitted.
allowed: clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12”
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The Danforth Music Hall does not have its own parking. There is paid public parking available on Danforth Avenue and the surrounding streets. Additionally, there is a Green P lot located behind Shoppers Drug Mart across the street from the venue.
lots: Green P lot behind Shoppers Drug Mart

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in The Danforth Music Hall's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at The Danforth Music Hall varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by The Danforth Music Hall, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in The Danforth Music Hall's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at The Danforth Music Hall. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at The Danforth Music Hall. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
